description: Hand-authored pixel rig for the desktop companion's sprites (OD-DESK-2). Coordinates are sprite pixels in the 64x88 character box. `eyes`: boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] closed by a blink (omitted where the drawing's eyes are already closed); `tear`: where the sad tear starts; `idle`: the idle motion style; `frame_ms`: the canonical idle frame time; `strip`: decoration removed from the source (the drawing's own Zzz; the companion animates its own); `patch`: light pixels repainted with a sampled colour (bubble-edge cleanup).
